tools.name: search_profitdrawer
tools.description: Searches the questions and answers published by ProfitDrawer on small business bookkeeping, taxes, pricing and money. Categories: Bookkeeping basics; Small business taxes; Start a business; Pricing and profit; Personal budgeting; Google Sheets and Excel how-tos; About ProfitDrawer files. Returns up

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns one answer published by ProfitDrawer by id: question, short answer, full detail, source with label, published and updated dates, answer page URL, Markdown URL, related questions, and the products and calculators the answer mentions. Ids come from search_profitdrawer.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the categories of ProfitDrawer's published answers with description, number of answers and category page URL.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Returns public facts about ProfitDrawer: description, website, founding year with its source, area served, currency, support channels, social profiles and other facts, each with a source. Includes the About page URL.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists ProfitDrawer products (spreadsheets, printables, templates, planners and printed goods) with name, price in USD, file formats, availability, product page URL and Etsy listing URL. Optional filters: words to match, collection, maximum price and file format.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Returns rows from the datasets published by ProfitDrawer: irs-small-business-tax-deadlines-2027 (IRS small business tax deadlines 2027); irs-standard-mileage-rates (IRS standard mileage rates for business use, 2020 to 2026). Each row includes its IRS source URL and the date it was checked. Optional:

tools.name: estimate_startup_costs
tools.description: Adds up one-time startup costs and monthly costs and works out cash left and months of runway (cash left divided by monthly costs, rounded down to 0.1, assuming no sales). Same formula as https://profitdrawer.com/tools/startup-cost-calculator.html. Optional preset with example amounts: Cleaning, Law

tools.name: calculate_price_per_job
tools.description: Works out a price for one service job: cost = hours x hourly pay + materials + travel + monthly overhead / jobs per month; price = cost / (1 - profit margin). Also returns profit per job, monthly revenue and break-even jobs per month. Same formula as https://profitdrawer.com/tools/price-per-job-calc

tools.name: calculate_loan_payoff
tools.description: Works out how many months a loan takes to pay off and the total interest, month by month (one month of interest = APR / 12 is added, then the payment is taken off), and what an optional extra monthly payment saves in interest and time. Same method as https://profitdrawer.com/tools/loan-payoff-calcul

tools.name: calculate_tax_set_aside
tools.description: Estimates how much of a self-employed profit to set aside for taxes: set-aside = profit x chosen percent, and the US self-employment tax part = profit x 92.35% x 15.3% (12.4% Social Security + 2.9% Medicare), per month, quarter or year. Same formula as https://profitdrawer.com/tools/self-employed-ta
